title: Family Tree
author: Somo team (XPRIZE Kenya)
description: The tree has a word ending such as -at. Drop a first-letter seed on it: a real word grows a fruit, a silly word grows a leaf. Level 3: make three new words from one family.
description_sw: Mti una mwisho wa neno kama -at. Dondosha mbegu ya herufi ya kwanza: neno halisi linazaa tunda, neno la kuchekesha linaota jani.

lines.en: Tap the green button to start.
Put each seed with {f} and read it. Is it a word you know?
lines.sw: Weka kila mbegu na {f} na usome. Ni neno unalolijua?

lines.en: This tree is the {f} family. Drop a letter seed on the tree to make a real word.
lines.sw: Mti huu ni familia ya {f}. Dondosha mbegu ya herufi kwenye mti kufanya neno halisi.

lines.en: New families now. Find a seed that makes a real word.
lines.sw: Familia mpya sasa. Tafuta mbegu inayofanya neno halisi.

lines.en: Now make three different real words from one family!
lines.sw: Sasa tengeneza maneno matatu tofauti halisi kutoka familia moja!

lines.en: The {f} family. Which seed makes a real word?
lines.sw: Familia ya {f}. Mbegu ipi inafanya neno halisi?

lines.en: The {f} family. Make three real words.
lines.sw: Familia ya {f}. Tengeneza maneno matatu halisi.

lines.en: {w}! A real word. A fruit grows.
{w} is a silly word, so a leaf grows. Try another seed.
lines.sw: {w} ni neno la kuchekesha, kwa hiyo jani linaota. Jaribu mbegu nyingine.
